_doc: 1.6.0 (de-robotization slice 1, 2026-08-15, review rework) — `vs_rfi` is
answered per seat as THREE bands: big blind, small blind, and everyone else.
An earlier draft put the two blinds in one node, which its own rationale
refutes — this pack notices money already in the pot, and that is exactly what
separates the two seats (0.5bb in against 1bb, 2.5bb to call against 2bb, and
only the big blind closes). Facing a raise the fold runs 33.32% in the big
blind, 43.22% elsewhere and 45.25% in the small blind, against a flat 43.44%.
⚠️ The catch-all does NOT call. The same earlier draft had this pack calling
a raise with ANY TWO CARDS — 32o from the small blind one time in three —
which the theory contract forbids outright (F11: the `vs_rfi` `*` catch-all is
3bet-or-fold) and which the F11 audit had already struck once. Two independent
reviewers caught it. The defensible junk is authored explicitly instead, as a
ramp: core, the offsuit band one rung outside it, then the band below that.
The boundaries elsewhere are ramps for the same reason — this pack was the
roster's clearest machine signature, limping or calling blocks 35% to 56% of
the deck wide at weight 1.0 and folding everything outside at 0. Combo-weighted
width is held: unopened 46.74 -> 46.78, vs_limpers 56.56 -> 56.53.
[UNVERIFIED] — the per-seat and fringe weights have no committed source; they
are scaled to hold this pack's pre-slice measured rates, which is the only
provenance claimed.
